question: Which river system originates from the Bastar hills of Madhya Pradesh?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Mahanadi River System**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The **Mahanadi River System** originates from the **Bastar hills** of Madhya Pradesh.
 
• The river flows through the states of **Chhattisgarh** and **Odisha** before emptying into the Bay of Bengal.
 
• The Mahanadi is known for its fertile plains and is a major source of irrigation in the region.
 
• It plays a crucial role in the agriculture and economy of the regions it flows through.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The Mahanadi River is approximately **858 kilometers** long.
 
• It is one of the major rivers in the peninsular region of India.
 
• The river basin is known for its rich mineral resources and is home to several important industrial towns.
 
• The **Hirakud Dam**, one of the longest dams in the world, is built across the Mahanadi River.
 
• The river has numerous tributaries including the Seonath, Jonk, and Hasdeo rivers.
